description: This file defines a class for secret detection and redaction in messages and prompts, used as a guardrail in LLM calls. It includes configuration for various secret detection plugins and methods for scanning and redacting secrets.

classes.name: _ENTERPRISE_SecretDetection
classes.description: A class extending CustomGuardrail that performs secret detection and redaction in messages and prompts during LLM calls.

methods.name: scan_message_for_secrets
methods.description: Scans a message content for secrets using configured plugins, returning detected secrets.

methods.name: should_run_check
methods.description: Determines if the secret detection check should run based on user API key permissions.

methods.name: async_pre_call_hook
methods.description: Pre-call hook that scans and redacts secrets in messages, prompts, and inputs before processing.
